ASHWANI KHANDELWAL 
DOCUMENT CONTROLLER 
 

 
 

28/10/1994 

  

 
 

 linkedin.com/in/ashwani-khandelwal-

b72669203 

 171-A, Vinoba Vihar, Model Town, 
Malviya Nagar, Jaipur-302017 
 

 
 CAREER BRIEF    TECHNICAL SKILLS 

Experienced Document Controller with over 6 years of expertise across 

diverse industries. Proficient in managing documentation workflows, 

quality reporting, and engineering submittals. Skilled in tools such as 

Oracle Primavera Unifier, Wrench, nPulse, DMS, SharePoint, and 

Microsoft Office. 

• Oracle Primavera Unifier 

• WRENCH 

• NPULSE 

• DMS 

• SharePoint 

• Microsoft Office 

EXPERIENCE SOFT SKILLS 
➢ Document Controller 
L&T TECHNOLOGY SERVICES                                  (MAR 2024 TO PRESENT) 
Project type: Chemical, Oil & Gas Projects 
Clients: HYCO1, Inc (USA), Deepak group (Gujarat), Saipem etc. 
Responsibilities: 

• Maintained and updated document control systems, ensuring timely 
submission and retrieval of documentation. 

• Implemented and enforced document control procedures to ensure 
compliance with project and company standards. 

• Coordinated with project teams to ensure all documentation was 
current, accurate, and properly filed. 

• Ensured traceability of documentation and revisions for audits and 
quality inspections. 

• Prepared and submitted weekly DCC Report to client, including status 
updates on deliverables & pending approvals. 

• Followed Transmittal system to deliver all the documents to client 
through internal EDMS tool and offline via email/SharePoint to ensure 
proper track record of the deliverables. 

 
 

➢ Document Controller & Administration 
CONSULTING ENGINEERS GROUP LIMITED        (JAN 2022 to MAR 2024) 
Project - Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Project 
Project Cost- 1,10,000 crore approximately 
Employer - National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) 
Working Package- C4 package which includes 237 kms. of stretch. 
Responsibilities:   

• Assisting planning team in making & publishing DPRs, WPRs, & MPRs 
on Oracle Primavera Unifier. 

• Recording & publishing Minutes of Meetings (MOMs) on Unifier. 
• Publishing Quality Reports like Cross Hole Sonic Logging (CHSL) Test 

Reports, Site Observation Reports (SORs), Non-Conformance Reports 
(NCRs), Corrective Action Reports (CARs) on Unifier. 

• Preparing & Maintaining Organogram flow chart for full package. 

• Good Communication Skills 

• Proven ability in work 

collaborations 

• Adaptable 

• Strong work ethics and dedication 

• Skilled in building working 

relationships. 

EDUCATION 
• MBA (FM) from S Gyan Vihar 

University (SGVU), Jaipur 

• B. Com from University of 

Rajasthan in 2014 

• Grade 12th & 10th from BSER 

AREA OF INTEREST 
• Dance & Choreography 

• Travelling 

• Cricket 

ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Represented Rajasthan in Four 

National Camps as a Cultural 

Lead in the National Service 

Scheme (NSS) program. 

• Volunteered in the Camps of 

Ministry of Youth Affairs & 

Sports from 2011 to 2014. 

https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashwani-khandelwal-b72669203
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashwani-khandelwal-b72669203

• Assigning RFIs to respective engineers & successfully closing from the

• Proficient in assisting HR & Admin Head in Maintaining the records of

➢ Store Executive 
REYA MODULAR KITCHEN & APPLIANCES (APR 2019 to OCT 2021)

• Managing all store operations and MIS. 
• Interacting with customers to understand their needs and desires. 
• Dealing with the vendors to finalize quotation of required goods. 
• Maintaining all sales & purchases, Income statement on Excel. 
 

➢ Account Executive                                             
TAMBI ASHOK & ASSOCIATES                                (APR 2018 to MAR 2019) 
Responsibilities: 

• Preparing data of goods and service tax. 
• Reconcile bank statement & vendor statement. 
• Maintaining proper accounting records & Files. 
• Assisting in Preparation of monthly financial reports.
